thought.text: Kunci penting: **"API access is pay-with-credits"** — tidak ada kredit API gratis otomatis. Saya verifikasi dan uji kualitas model uncensored-nya langsung.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 "https://docs.venice.ai/guides/getting-started/quick-start" -o /tmp/q.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; python3 - <<'PY'
import re,html
s=open('/tmp/q.html',errors='ignore').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
for kw in ['free','credit','balance','\\$']:
    for m in re.finditer(kw,t,re.I):
        seg=t[max(0,m.start()-140):m.start()+180]
        if any(k in seg.lower() for k in ['credit','free tier','balance','top up']):
            print('...',seg.strip()[:300],'\n'); break
PY
